Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the
intersection in Katy, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the facts. I'm the driver of the car that was hit on the passenger side.
Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?
A: I was heading through the intersection on a green light. The other vehicle came from my right and didn't stop for its
red signal. I had no time to brake.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?
A: Only for a second. It was already in the crosswalk area when I noticed it. I tried to swerve, but the impact came
almost right away.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, and the airbag deployed on my side.
Q: Did you receive medical attention after the crash?
A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They diagnosed a concussion. I've had headaches, dizziness, and
trouble concentrating since then.
Q: Are you currently under a doctor's care?
A: Yes. I have a follow-up with my neurologist and I've been told to limit screen time and driving until I'm cleared.
Q: Did anyone else in your vehicle get hurt?
A: No, I was alone in the car.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct in this statement?
A: Only that I want the record to show I've been cooperative and I'm still dealing with symptoms every day.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
